senses.gloss: m. (b. h.; = תאו, v. אָוָה II; cmp. b. h. תָּאָה) cell, esp. compartment back of the Holy of Holies.
units: B. Bath. 61ᵃ an extension has three names: יציע … תא yatsiʿa, tselʿa, ta.— Pl. תָּאִים, תָּאִין.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:21">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 28</cite> <he>בת׳ היה טמון</he> Joash was kept hidden in the compartments of the Temple.
